newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CEF acquires Banorte's mortgage portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CEF acquires Banorte's mortgage portfolio.

text.p: Brazilian state-run bank Caixa Economica Federal (CEF) said Friday it has assumed the mortgage portfolio of Banorte, which was acquired by Banco Bandeirantes earlier this year.
CEF will receive 786 million reais in credit lines under the government's PROER program to take over the mortgage portfolio, the bank said in a statement.
The PROER program is designed to finance mergers and acquisitions in the banking sector.
Of that total, 432 million reais will be used to pay Banorte for the purchase of the portfolio and 230 million reais is earmarked to pay off debts Banorte owes to Caixa, the statement added.
